pages.text: $(l)$(5)Soul Magic$()$(br2)Within our world, every living being has a soul, that soul contains energy, and that energy can be harnessed for such things as crafting spirit trinkets, forging arcane pacts, practicing totemic rites, performing magical rituals, and much, much more.$(br2)
The Encyclopedia Arcana contains all the research you will need to study soul magic.

Soulstone is an magical ore you can find when mining. In its refined form it has many uses in $(o)many$() of the practices of soul magic. Refined Soulstone is needed as well to craft the Encyclopedia Arcana.
Soulstone can be refined simply by smelting Soulstone Ore or Raw Soulstone in a Furnace or Blast Furnace.
